coreSegments.name: Number / sheet-related segment
coreSegments.composition: The source fields are concatenated inside one segment; no hyphen is inserted between them. Drawings use one sheet-type digit plus two sheet-sub-type digits and optional trailing digits. Specifications use the CSI/MasterFormat components; the example is 26 + 50 + 00 = 265000.

coreSegments.name: Floor level + plan area
coreSegments.composition: Floor Level is mandatory and Plan Area is appended in the same segment when applicable: 00 + C = 00C. XX represents a non-applicable floor level.
